Title: L1, human normal pancreatic tissue
Sample_extract_protocol_ch1: RNA of normal pancreatic specimens were purchased commercially. Trizol extraction of total RNA was performed on PDAC and adjacent benign specimens according to the manufacturer's instructions.
Sample_label_protocol_ch1: Total RNA (100 ng)Technologies) according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
Sample_hyb_protocol: Labeled RNA was hybridized to a Agilent human geneexpression microarray according to the manufacturer's instructions.
Sample_scan_protocol: Arrays were scanned using the Agilent G2565CA manufacturer's instructions.
Sample_data_processing: Probe intensities were extracted using FeatureExtraction software (Agilent). Value definition Probe intensities were background corrected and normalized (quantile normalization) using the LIMMA package in R.
